Owls are nocturnal birds, which means they are active at night. They have excellent hearing and can turn their heads almost all the way around. Their large eyes help them see in the dark.

What is the main idea?
choices: A) Owls can turn their heads.
B) Owls are nocturnal birds with special features for nighttime.
D) All birds are active at night.

branches: Turn heads almost all the way

The rainforest has lots of cool stuff in it.

questions.question:

What is Maria preparing for?
choices: B) A trip to the store

questions.question:
Read the passage.

The Great Wall of China is one of the most famous structures in the world. It stretches over 13,000 miles. The wall was built over many centuries to protect China from invaders.

Which detail tells why the wall was built?
choices: A) It is one of the most famous structures.
C) It was built to protect China from invaders.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses a conjunction to join two ideas?

B) I like pizza, but I don't like mushrooms on it.
C) I like pizza but, I don't like mushrooms on it.
D) I like pizza. But I don't, like mushrooms on it.

What does this tell the reader about Alex?
choices: A) He is lost and confused.
B) He is adventurous and brave.
C) He always picks the easy way.
D) He does not like the forest.

Sleep is important for growing children. When you sleep, your body repairs itself and your brain stores what you learned during the day. Try to get at least nine hours of sleep each night.
